definitions.explanation: A person who installs and repairs pipes for water, gas, and sewage systems.

examples.japanese: {配管工|はいかんこう}を{呼|よ}んで{水漏|みずも}れを{直|なお}してもらった。
examples.english: I called a plumber to fix the water leak.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{配管工|はいかんこう}として30{年|ねん}{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: My father has been working as a plumber for 30 years.

examples.japanese: {配管工|はいかんこう}になるには{資格|しかく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: You need qualifications to become a plumber.

notes:
RELATED OCCUPATIONS:
・{電気工事士|でんきこうじし} (electrician)
・{大工|だいく} (carpenter)
・{左官|さかん} (plasterer)
・{建築作業員|けんちくさぎょういん} (construction worker)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{配管工|はいかんこう}を{呼|よ}ぶ (to call a plumber)
・{配管工|はいかんこう}に{頼|たの}む (to request a plumber)
・{配管工|はいかんこう}の{仕事|しごと} (plumber's work)

USAGE NOTE: The term {水道屋|すいどうや}さん is often used colloquially for plumbers who fix residential water issues.
